_TBD_ (RH5-00)

## Problem

Local working trees re-accumulate root clutter that fails `--strict-untracked` even when gitignored patterns are incomplete or agents drop new names:

Observed / expected families (audit + RH4 residual):

| Path / pattern | Class |
| --- | --- |
| `.tmp_*`, `_fail_*.txt`, `bash.exe.stackdump`, `nul`/`NUL` | generated local |
| agent `_tmp_*.py` / `_cr_*.py` if recreated | scratch |
| `logs/` if recreated | forbidden long-lived root sink (prefer `reports/logs/`) |
| `.env` / `.env.local` | secret lane — **do not automate delete/edit** |

## Scope

- [ ] Document operator purge steps in closeout comment / optional one-liner in `docs/00-project/governance/root-local-clutter-cleanup.md` if drift exists
- [ ] Locally delete safe ignored clutter (tmp, stackdump, nul) — not secrets
- [ ] Optional harden `.gitignore` for `/_cr_*.py` and similar agent scratch **without** tracking new root files
- [ ] Run `check-cleanliness --strict-untracked --check-local-forbidden-outputs` on a clean tree

## Out of scope

- Touching `.env` / `.env.local` content without explicit user approval
- Expanding allowlist

## Acceptance

- [ ] Strict-untracked cleanliness green on contributor-clean tree  
- [ ] No secret files committed  
- [ ] Guidance points agents to `scripts/**` / `reports/**` for outputs
